## Goals for 2026/2027

The main goal for TAF in 2026/2027 is an end-to-end process in which:

- an ICES scientist writes code to produce scientific advice
- the code is checked automatically against agreed standards and stored with its metadata
- valid code is executed automatically to produce results, plots and tables, which are also stored
- the results are publicly accessible
- the tafXplorer gives a consistent, easy to navigate way to explore stock assessments

The full description and diagram are in the [architecture introduction](../system/index.qmd). Progress towards these goals is tracked by workstream on the [workstreams](workstreams.qmd) page.

## Team composition

The current TAF team is composed of a thematic lead (full time), developer (2 days), student developer (2 days), graphical data scientist (2 days), strategy coordinator (3 days), process (0.5 days), with additional support from the data managent team lead, and developer team lead.

## How work is prioritised

WGTAFGOV meets quarterly to prioritise issues. Issues are raised in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/ices-eg/wg_WGTAFGOV/issues), assigned to a workstream with a `Sprint:` label, and scheduled on the [project board](https://github.com/orgs/ices-eg/projects/10).
